policy: Match named game and description; correct clearly wrong IDs.

changes.title: Cobra: Game of the Normandy Breakout
changes.canonical_name: Cobra: Game of the Normandy Breakout
changes.reason: Named SPI Normandy breakout game, not wordXchange.

changes.title: Dirtside II
changes.reason: Named Ground Zero Games science-fiction miniature rules, not Carcassonne: The River.

changes.title: Don't Drop the Soap
changes.reason: Description is 59-card hot-potato game by Pedersen, not 2007 Sebelius six-location board game.

changes.title: Game of the Generals
changes.reason: Named Philippine Salpakan with human arbiter, not electronic 1980 The Generals reimplementation.

changes.title: Granada: The Fall of Moslem Spain
changes.canonical_name: Granada: The Fall of Moslem Spain
changes.reason: Named 2003 Robert Markham/Avalanche Press Reconquista wargame, not the 2009 Queen Games city-building Granada.

changes.title: Mall Madness
changes.reason: Description is the full-size talking electronic 3D shopping-mall game, not the cassette-sized Flipsiders Mall Madness.

changes.title: Thunder Road: Vendetta
changes.reason: Named Restoration Games 2023 Vendetta, with hazards, damage tokens and command board, not the original 1986 Milton Bradley Thunder Road.

changes.title: Apocalypse
changes.reason: Named 1976 C. S. Elliott simultaneous-move chess variant with two knights and five pawns per side, not Classic Warlord or Games Workshop nuclear-war Apocalypse.

changes.title: Cardino
changes.reason: Named Cardino matches Cartino, the 1969 playing-card-suit tile-placement game; Cardino is an explicit primary BGG alternate name. Correct identity is 2116, not stored Bezique 2405, a traditional trick-taking card game. The archive links a matching original Ravensburger Cartino rulebook. Summary publisher and gameplay details remain unaudited.

changes.title: Battle of the Bulge
changes.canonical_name: The Big Red One: The Game of the First Infantry Division at the Battle of the Bulge
changes.reason: Named summary explicitly describes Jim Dunnigan/SPI 1979 divisional Bulge, with daily turns, 8-km hexes, two combat tables, weather/air power and bridge-interdicted supply. Primary 4252 lists Bulge: The Battle for the Ardennes as an alternate and describes that same supply/victory system. Original SPI 1979 manual title and contents visually match. Stored 16444 is the separate Avalon Hill 1965 game by Pinsky/Shaw. Preserve the original named target and correct its ID to 4252; no claim of summary accuracy.

changes.title: Gridlock
changes.reason: Named description is Andrew Looneys 1997 Icehouse-pyramid chessboard game with placement/drop phases and directional turning. Primary BGG 35205 identifies that exact game and designer and links the same Wunderland creator rules. Stored 22428 is now an administrative Outside the Scope of BGG catch-all, not this game. Preserve original ID and named target; correct to 35205. No full summary accuracy claim.

Named description exactly matches Alex Raullis contributed Pagat 3,6,9 trick-taking card game: 52 cards/no trump, 3/6/9-trick negative scoring, captured-threes bonus and identical three/five-player card-removal variants. Stored BGG 32597 is Paul Townsends unrelated shared-stone abstract game. Withdraw that known wrong ID; no replacement BGG ID is confirmed. Explicit unresolved-ID status, original ID and primary matching source preserve traceability without inventing an association.

changes.title: Pole Position
changes.reason: Named summary explicitly identifies Parker Brothers and a 2–4-player first-car racing game. Primary BGG 2732 is the 1983 Parker Brothers arcade adaptation with movement cards and one car per player. Stored 7993 identifies Gerhard Kodys 1989 Piatnik game with three cars per player, simultaneous numbered-card selection and combined placement scoring. Preserve the original named target and ID history; correct the association to 2732. Detailed summary dice/speed/lap claims remain unaudited.

changes.title: Gespensterburg
changes.reason: Named Noris game and description explicitly match the 1994 Johann/Michael Rüttinger trivia, rhyme, tongue-twister race to the Black Raven, BGG103192. Original229553is the unrelated1990REMUS cassette/spinner game. Correct ID under user instruction; preserve original and earlier wrong-target research as history. Source discovery does not certify the generated summary.
